desc:
Cute Hair UGC Obby is a pastel obby where you beat the stages, wait out the timers, and unlock cute UGC items for your avatar! 💗

HOW IT WORKS
• Beat the obby to unlock your first item
• Days 1–7 each unlock a new item
• Finish Day 7 + a 10-hour timer to unlock the LIMITED item
• AFK or play: timers run while you're in the game, and your progress saves

GOOD TO KNOW
• Every item can be earned without Robux by playing or waiting
• Optional Robux skips just make it faster
• Limited items have limited stock. Once they run out, they're gone
• Thumbnails show the items currently in the game

⭐ Like + favorite to get notified when new items drop!
